meta.name: contract-helper
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "draft an influencer contract", "review these agreement terms", or "build a partnership template"; produces a full influencer agreement framework (scope, compensation, usage rights, exclusivity, FTC disclosure), a clause-by-clause review with red flags, and a negotiation cheat sheet. Not for outreach negotiation before a deal exists — use outreach-manager.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 起草和审阅网红合作协议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成或审查网红合作合同。
copy.tagline_en: Draft and review influencer partnership agreements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate or review influencer contracts.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你起草或审核网红合作协议。它会生成一份完整的协议框架（包括合作范围、报酬、使用权、独家条款、FTC 披露），逐条审查合同并标出风险点，还会提供谈判要点清单。
howto.when: 当你要求“起草一份网红合同”、“审查这些协议条款”或“制作合作模板”时触发。也适用于解释标准条款或构建可复用的合作模板。

say.text: 起草一份网红合作协议，2条Instagram帖子，报酬500美元。
审查这份网红经纪公司的合同条款：[粘贴条款]。
say.note: Claude 会逐条审查，列出缺失条款和风险点。

say.text: 帮我解释一下合同中的独家条款是什么意思。
say.note: Claude 会解释该条款的内容、重要性及注意事项。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can draft or review influencer partnership agreements. It produces a full agreement framework (scope, compensation, usage rights, exclusivity, FTC disclosure), performs a clause-by-clause review with red flags, and provides a negotiation cheat sheet.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "draft an influencer contract", "review these agreement terms", or "build a partnership template". Also suitable for explaining standard clauses or creating reusable templates.

say_en.text: Draft an influencer agreement for 2 Instagram posts for $500.
say_en.note: Claude generates a simplified agreement with core terms.

say_en.text: Review these contract terms from an influencer agency: [paste terms].
say_en.note: Claude reviews clause by clause, listing missing terms and red flags.

say_en.text: Explain what the exclusivity clause means in a contract.
say_en.note: Claude explains the clause's coverage, importance, and watch-outs.
